services.desc: Group tickets may be reserved with a 25% deposit due 60 days before the performance, with the remaining balance due 30 days prior to the performance date through Lesher Center Group Sales. Reservations are not secured until the 25% non‑refundable deposit is received. At final payment, orders may be reduced by up to 10%. Checks should be made payable to Lesher Center for the Arts and mailed to: Lesher Center for the Arts, Attn: Group Sales, 1601 Civic Dr, Walnut Creek, CA 94596. Please include your order number; only one check per order is accepted. Deposits are non‑refundable, returned checks incur a $40 fee, and Purchase Orders are not accepted. To support a safe and positive experience
